notes.title: Class of Heroes 3 is coming on 18th September 2025
notes.notes:
[p]If you enjoy the Class of Heroes series, you’ll be pleased to know that [b]Class of Heroes 3 Remaster is coming on 18th September, 2025![/b][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="kzICEVJisBU;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]The return of Class of Heroes is near, and the wait is almost over. Grab your school bag and dust off those books, it’s time to step into the shoes of a student once again and enroll in a brand-new academy.[/p][p]This time you will  be able to pick from 3 academies, all offering a wide variety of classes spreading across multiple races. Prepare to dive into challenging quests, sprawling dungeons, and tactical battles against fearsome monsters. Every step forward demands caution and preparation. [/p][p][b]Reminder: Don’t underestimate your enemies, you may not live to regret it![/b][/p][p]Strategic party-building is your key to survival. Level up your students, gather powerful loot, and refine your team along the way. Whether you choose to adventure with the default party or create custom students from scratch, you’ll assign skill points based on race and class, tailoring your strategy to suit your playstyle.[/p][p]Class of Heroes 3 Remaster also introduces a host of new features and enhancements, including a greater item and weapon count to help you through.[/p][p]And for the first time, you’ll be able to build a character relationship chart, choose who your party members like or dislike, and unlock unique abilities and skill sets based on those bonds. Use their relationships to your tactical advantage![/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Class of Heroes 3 Remaster is Coming in 2025!
notes.notes:
It’s Official!

Class of Heroes 3 Remaster is coming in 2025!

If you loved playing Class of Heroes 2G: Remaster Edition, you’re going to love this!

Choose from three different schools to start your adventure, team up with new classmates, and dive into thrilling dungeon-crawling quests. Meet an exciting cast of friends, each offering a wider range of characters and classes to explore.

With endless combinations of races, classes, and gear, you can build your dream team and tackle dungeons packed with epic challenges - an adventure no fan of the series should miss!

Get ready for Class of Heroes 3 Remaster—Coming 2025!

notes.title: New patch update!
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Thank you for playing Class of Heroes 2G: Remaster Edition and sharing your feedback with us.
A new patch has now been released, addressing the below issues: 

・Fixed a bug in which certain actions caused party members on standby to be replaced by a Level 0 character
・Fixed a bug in which BGM volume settings were not saved
・Fixed misaligned translations on command menu at Bruschetta dorm
・Fixed a bug in which certain trophies and titles were not unlocking
・Added voice volume adjustment option
・Fixed erroneous recipes

Keep adventuring!

notes.title: Races in Class of Heroes 2G: Remastered, Part 2
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758764/294a5172be12c2bd77dffc5a20b5880c4cfba8d7.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758764/b704c021f1a911ea05ab34c70884594a2d1a5572.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758764/a5f336f2145a0e6b12bc20b9c9b7e179664c38e1.gif[/img]

[b]Elves[/b] are commonly known as a [b]well-balanced[/b] race, often likened to [b]Humans[/b], but with distinguished characteristics of [b]pointy ears[/b] and [b]glorious hair[/b]. While they do share similarities with [b]Humans, Elves[/b] place notable emphasis on their [b]wisdom[/b] and[b] faith[/b], reflecting their spiritual inclinations. Their [b]vitality[/b] ranks as their [b]lowest statistic[/b], and their[b] HP growth[/b] progresses slower than that of other races. These factors present a challenge for [b]Elves[/b] when considering frontline positions.   

They can enrol in a variety of classes such as[b] Common, Fighter, Mage, Ranger, Ninja, Idol,[/b] and [b]Summoner[/b], allowing them to further develop their skills and abilities. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758764/fb6eae9e69d6cc2a4847bff06ef5e90feab2fc84.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758764/655f40b39fa43787d4597ad05abfbb36bdc5bc33.gif[/img]

[b]Gnomes[/b] may seem like they are ready to charge into battle, but they are most likely to trip over their own feet! They have significantly [b]low strength[/b] and [b]lacklustre HP growth[/b]. But fear not! These little blue-haired guys are known for their [b]excellent wisdom[/b] and [b]faith[/b]. This makes them awesome candidates for the backline! [b]Gnomes[/b] are known to be [b]invisible spirits[/b], this comes in great when they can showcase their[b] levitation act[/b] in dangerous parts of the labyrinths, avoiding [b]shock tiles[/b] on both the floor and walls. These are the only Race that can avoid all shock waves. To add to this, they can also enrol in courses like [b]Common, Fighter, Monk, Ranger, Idol, [/b]and [b]Alchemist,[/b] helping them stumble into greatness. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758764/cdf919f95a28f8b2b364db20e85ee6baac4f39b3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758764/fd530885c980610792114acc95fd61c149258f5f.gif[/img]

[b]Fairies[/b] may look all [b]magical[/b], but their skills lie in [b]agility[/b] and [b]luck[/b] rather than spellcasting. This makes them ideal for mastering [b]agility-based [/b]and the art of [b]thievery [/b]majors.  Enrolling them into a variety of classes, like [b]Common, Fighter, Ranger, [/b]and [b]Idol[/b], will allow their skills to improve and help them become the masters of mischief!  

Just like their diminutive cousins, the [b]Gnomes, Fairies[/b] can also use their [b]wings to levitate[/b]. This will give them an advantage when dodging pesky [b]shock tiles[/b], but be aware, they can only avoid the ones on the ground. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758764/57abda4a10a65820649feccde2da4ff1bdf07a95.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758764/1ac21e16d76c734260882011cebd95d27c3d8531.gif[/img]

 
The celestial beings known as the [b]Celestia [/b]Race have exceptionally [b]high faith statistics[/b], making them the epitome of perfect healers! Entrusting them with your party's well-being is a no-brainer, which is why keeping them safely tucked away in the backline is the most sensible choice. This race has the most [b]delicate look,[/b] with majestic [b]wings[/b] and a light [b]ability to float[/b]. Enrolling them into classes, [b]Common, Fighter, Mage, Swordsman, Ninja, Idol,[/b] and even [b]Fallen Angel[/b], can help unleash the heavenly chaos they hold. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758764/278a88793c0d8aaed56a500aa3494e7168da2f7f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758764/495f6230905edfe2dc996f3709f95972f670b242.gif[/img]

[b]Khulaz[/b] are graced with remarkable [b]agility[/b] and [b]luck statistics[/b]. They are the ultimate team players, destined to be the squad's most loveable mascot! These little bundles of Luck are short but mighty and often seen wearing their signature [b]beany hats[/b] into battle. With this cozy attire, they are offered the chance to enrol in a variety of classes, such as [b]Common, Fighter, Ranger, Puppeteer, Ninja, Idol,[/b] and [b]Geomancer.[/b]

notes.title: Races In Class of Heroes 2G: Remastered, Part 1
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758764/7085626491dbb649bc3ae0628fa25908e7e3c3a4.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758764/b03eddff3bc6ae3dc1795c9f1ea39e89bddf63e8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758764/5f849e9137931a7c2a22cf4639da3ea2e67202f1.gif[/img]

When it comes to [b]versatility[/b], [b]Humans[/b] win. They are adaptable to most majors and can deal with any situation thrown their way. However, all this [b]flexibility[/b] does come with a cost, a [b]shorter lifespan[/b]. And while they have [b]no special skill[/b], being able to move around as desired is a great advantage. 
[b]Humans[/b] can enrol in most of the majors available: [b]Common, Fighter, Monk, Ranger, Puppeteer, Swordsman, Ninja, Idol[/b] and [b]Gunner[/b]. They are the perfect race for kicking off a new party or diving headfirst into the labyrinth of adventure!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758764/22b27b49aa8daba04e9651ef7f37be754dbcd63d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758764/9f6eef2bdaf3e9cece3a7ee8d19079eb3b9a0f36.gif[/img]

[b]Dwarves[/b] are famed for their resilience thanks to their [b]remarkable strength[/b] and [b]vitality statistics[/b]. Additionally, their generous dose of [b]faith[/b] adds further value to the team. These traits combined with any bonus statistics you give make them ideal contenders for the frontline. The majors that are available to this race are [b]Common, Fighter, Monk, Swordsman, Idol,[/b] and [b]Berserker[/b]. These little furry adventurers are keen to explore the dungeons.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758764/176430ad8b34075c275f19d574eb4277d5354456.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758764/5c6bbb361fbf4c47dccd73ff1540ed856f48fa82.gif[/img]

[b]Felpurrs[/b], who resemble humans with their adorable ears and tails, are acknowledged for their [b]remarkable strength[/b] and [b]vitality[/b]. Not only do they have [b]substantial HP gain[/b], but they have great [b]capability for progression[/b] to a stronger race. Their nimble nature makes them valuable party members in dungeon crawling, as they exhibit swift thinking and decision-making in combat situations. Opting for one of their available majors—[b]Common, Fighter, Monk, Swordsman, Idol,[/b] and later, [b]Beas[/b]t—can significantly boost your team's progress!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758764/55b9cd1ab0f29f36e1e10d48ba33b310082eea93.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758764/f631a83f7eb33e0f437ca07de7c4cf3f85ac02f8.gif[/img]

[b]Bahamoons[/b] generally swing swords first and ask questions later. Their [b]raw strength[/b] and [b]vitality are exceptional[/b], making them nearly unstoppable with [b]weapons[/b] and [b]armour.[/b] While they may not excel in magic, faith, or wisdom, Bahamoons possess an advantage, the ability to unleash a [b]special attack[/b] known as the [b]'breath'[/b], enabling them to overcome enemies resistant to physical attacks. 
They also have the option to further refine their skills by enrolling in various majors tailored to their preferences and strengths such as,[b] Common, Fighter, Monk, Idol,[/b] and [b]Dragon Knight[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758764/975ac60d68b121c8c8906bcf84d5c32fbbcf9884.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758764/0a533a4995cafd5ab38b30973d0800dc17bf33e1.gif[/img]

[b]Diabolos[/b] are arguably the most [b]formidable[/b] race. Not only do they have [b]impressive HP growth[/b], but they also have stern faces and intimidating horns, giving off serious "don't mess with us" vibes. Making them perfect to be the frontline. Additionally, they have the option to enrol in majors advancing their talents with the choices of, [b]Common, Fighter, Mage, Puppeteer, Ninja, Idol[/b], and [b]Necromancer[/b]. 

As if their attitude wasn't enough to scare off enemies, they also have the skill to perform [b]'breath'[/b] attacks.

notes.title: Class of Heroes 2G: Remaster Edition is coming to Steam!
notes.notes:
Exciting news Adventurers, Class of Heroes 2G is returning, remastered!

A call for brave students awaits at the doors of Crostini Academy. Prepare yourself for nostalgia as you take on a classic dungeon crawler, full of exploration, combat, and endless opportunities.

Build up your dream teams, level them up and try not to kill them, travel across 3 different school, and change your mind over and over again about what course your students are taking.

Prepare yourself for upgraded graphics, fully voiced story, and slicker gameplay than ever!

Wishlist now to be notified on release!
